## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!quiz` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "title": "Coffee trivia",
  "questions": [
    {
      "q": "Which country grows the most coffee in the world?",
      "choices": [
        "Colombia",
        "Brazil",
        "Vietnam",
        "Ethiopia"
      ],
      "answer": 1
    },
    {
      "q": "An espresso marked with just a small spoonful of milk foam is called a…",
      "choices": [
        "Latte",
        "Flat white",
        "Macchiato",
        "Americano"
      ],
      "answer": 2
    },
    {
      "q": "Coffee beans are the seeds of which part of the coffee plant?",
      "choices": [
        "The cherry-like fruit",
        "The flower",
        "The root",
        "The leaf"
      ],
      "answer": 0
    },
    {
      "q": "A popular legend says a goat herder noticed his goats getting lively after nibbling coffee berries. In which country is this story usually set?",
      "choices": [
        "Yemen",
        "Turkey",
        "Italy",
        "Ethiopia"
      ],
      "answer": 3
    },
    {
      "q": "What does a cup of decaf coffee still contain?",
      "choices": [
        "No caffeine at all",
        "A small amount of caffeine",
        "More caffeine than regular",
        "Only added sugar"
      ],
      "answer": 1
    }
  ]
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --grape: #b44cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --soft: #574b82; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--ink) 0%, #3f27a3 50%, var(--grape) 100%); color: #fff; font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; overflow: hidden; }
  button { font-family: inherit; }
  header { flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
  h1 { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #count { flex: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  #dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; }
  #dots i { flex: 1; height: 8px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .22); transition: background .2s; }
  #dots i.now { background: #fff; }
  #dots i.ok { background: var(--mint); }
  #dots i.bad { background: var(--pink); }
  #game, #result { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  #game[hidden], #result[hidden] { display: none; }
  #question { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .25); }
  #question span { display: block; width: 100%; }
  #choices { flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .choice { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 5px 10px 5px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .45); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s, box-shadow .1s, background .2s, opacity .2s; }
  .choice:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .45); }
  .choice:disabled { cursor: default; }
  .badge { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 11px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
  .choice:nth-child(1) .badge { background: var(--pink); }
  .choice:nth-child(2) .badge { background: var(--orange); }
  .choice:nth-child(3) .badge { background: var(--sky); }
  .choice:nth-child(4) .badge { background: var(--yellow); }
  .text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .choice.right { background: var(--mint); animation: pop .3s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1); }
  .choice.wrong { background: var(--pink); animation: shake .3s; }
  .choice.right .badge, .choice.wrong .badge { background: #fff; }
  .choice.dim { opacity: .7; }
  .primary:focus-visible, .choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
  .foot { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; }
  #feedback { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-height: 40px; overflow: hidden; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 800; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; }
  .primary { flex: none; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c98a06; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s, box-shadow .1s; }
  .primary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c98a06; }
  #next.wait { visibility: hidden; }
  #result { align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
  #medal { font-size: 54px; line-height: 1; animation: pop .5s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1); }
  #final { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #final small { font-size: 22px; opacity: .85; }
  #tier { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--yellow); }
  #blurb { max-width: 280px; font-size: 15px; }
  #review { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  #review i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
  #review i.ok { background: var(--mint); }
  #review i.bad { background: var(--pink); }
  @keyframes pop { 0% { transform: scale(.85); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
  @keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-5px); } 75% { transform: translateX(5px); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .choice, #medal { animation: none !important; transition: none; } }
  .sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
</style>
<header>
  <div class="top">
    <h1 id="title">Coffee trivia</h1>
    <span id="count">Question 1 of 5</span>
  </div>
  <div id="dots" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</header>
<div id="game">
  <div id="question"><span id="qtext"></span></div>
  <div id="choices"></div>
  <div class="foot">
    <div id="feedback" aria-live="polite">Pick an answer</div>
    <button id="next" class="primary wait" type="button">Next</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="result" hidden>
  <div id="medal" aria-hidden="true">🏆</div>
  <div id="final"></div>
  <div id="tier" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div id="blurb"></div>
  <div id="review"></div>
  <button id="again" class="primary" type="button">Play again</button>
</div>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = { pick: 'Pick an answer', right: '✓ Correct!', wrong: '✗ Not quite. It is ', next: 'Next', finish: 'See score', of: ' of ', question: 'Question ' };
  var TIERS = [
    { min: 1, medal: '🏆', title: 'Perfect score!', blurb: 'Every answer right. Take a bow.' },
    { min: .6, medal: '🎉', title: 'Great job!', blurb: 'You really know your stuff.' },
    { min: .2, medal: '🙂', title: 'Warming up', blurb: 'A few more rounds and you will ace it.' },
    { min: 0, medal: '🌱', title: 'Fresh start', blurb: 'Every expert started somewhere. Try again!' }
  ];
  var EXAMPLE = { title: 'Example quiz', questions: [
    { q: 'This is an example question. Which option is correct?', choices: ['Option A', 'Option B', 'Option C'], answer: 1 },
    { q: 'Your bot sends the real questions. Tap the third option.', choices: ['First', 'Second', 'Third'], answer: 2 }
  ] };
  var LETTERS = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];

  function clean(data) {
    var list = data && data.questions && data.questions.length ? data.questions : [];
    return list.filter(function (item) {
      return item && item.q && item.choices && item.choices.length >= 2 && item.choices.length <= 4 && item.answer >= 0 && item.answer < item.choices.length;
    }).map(function (item) {
      return { q: String(item.q), choices: item.choices.map(String), answer: Math.floor(item.answer) };
    });
  }

  var quiz = clean(DATA);
  var title = DATA && DATA.title ? String(DATA.title) : EXAMPLE.title;
  if (!quiz.length) { quiz = clean(EXAMPLE); title = EXAMPLE.title; }

  var titleEl = document.getElementById('title');
  var countEl = document.getElementById('count');
  var dotsEl = document.getElementById('dots');
  var gameEl = document.getElementById('game');
  var resultEl = document.getElementById('result');
  var questionEl = document.getElementById('question');
  var qtextEl = document.getElementById('qtext');
  var choicesEl = document.getElementById('choices');
  var feedbackEl = document.getElementById('feedback');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('next');
  var round, index, answers, answered;

  titleEl.textContent = title;
  for (var d = 0; d < quiz.length; d++) dotsEl.appendChild(document.createElement('i'));

  function shuffle(list) {
    var a = list.slice();
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)), t = a[i];
      a[i] = a[j];
      a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }

  // Each round keeps the original choice index so the answer check survives a reshuffle.
  function buildRound(mix) {
    return quiz.map(function (item) {
      var order = item.choices.map(function (_, i) { return i; });
      return { q: item.q, answer: item.answer, choices: item.choices, order: mix ? shuffle(order) : order };
    });
  }

  function start(mix) {
    round = buildRound(mix);
    index = 0;
    answers = [];
    resultEl.hidden = true;
    gameEl.hidden = false;
    show();
  }

  function paintDots() {
    var dots = dotsEl.children;
    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
      dots[i].className = i < answers.length ? (answers[i] ? 'ok' : 'bad') : (i === index && resultEl.hidden ? 'now' : '');
    }
  }

  function show() {
    var item = round[index];
    answered = false;
    countEl.textContent = TEXT.question + (index + 1) + TEXT.of + round.length;
    qtextEl.textContent = item.q;
    choicesEl.innerHTML = '';
    item.order.forEach(function (orig, pos) {
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'choice';
      btn.setAttribute('data-orig', orig);
      var badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'badge';
      badge.textContent = LETTERS[pos];
      var text = document.createElement('span');
      text.className = 'text';
      text.textContent = item.choices[orig];
      btn.appendChild(badge);
      btn.appendChild(text);
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { choose(btn, orig); });
      choicesEl.appendChild(btn);
    });
    feedbackEl.textContent = TEXT.pick;
    nextBtn.className = 'primary wait';
    nextBtn.textContent = index === round.length - 1 ? TEXT.finish : TEXT.next;
    paintDots();
    fit();
  }

  // Long questions shrink step by step until the whole screen fits the card height.
  function fit() {
    var cs = choicesEl.querySelectorAll('.choice');
    for (var size = 19; size >= 12; size--) {
      var choiceSize = Math.min(15, Math.max(13, size));
      for (var i = 0; i < cs.length; i++) cs[i].style.fontSize = choiceSize + 'px';
      qtextEl.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
      if (qtextEl.offsetHeight <= questionEl.clientHeight - 16) break;
    }
  }

  function choose(btn, orig) {
    if (answered) return;
    answered = true;
    var item = round[index], correct = orig === item.answer;
    answers.push(correct);
    var all = choicesEl.querySelectorAll('.choice');
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      var b = all[i], o = +b.getAttribute('data-orig');
      b.disabled = true;
      if (o === item.answer) {
        b.classList.add('right');
        b.querySelector('.badge').textContent = '✓';
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Correct answer: ' + item.choices[o]);
      } else if (b === btn) {
        b.classList.add('wrong');
        b.querySelector('.badge').textContent = '✗';
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Your pick, wrong: ' + item.choices[o]);
      } else {
        b.classList.add('dim');
      }
    }
    feedbackEl.textContent = correct ? TEXT.right : TEXT.wrong + item.choices[item.answer] + '.';
    nextBtn.className = 'primary';
    paintDots();
    fit();
    nextBtn.focus();
  }

  function next() {
    if (!answered) return;
    if (index < round.length - 1) {
      index++;
      show();
      var first = choicesEl.querySelector('.choice');
      if (first) first.focus();
      return;
    }
    finish();
  }

  function finish() {
    var score = answers.filter(Boolean).length, share = score / round.length, tier = TIERS[TIERS.length - 1];
    for (var i = 0; i < TIERS.length; i++) if (share >= TIERS[i].min) { tier = TIERS[i]; break; }
    gameEl.hidden = true;
    resultEl.hidden = false;
    countEl.textContent = 'Done';
    document.getElementById('medal').textContent = tier.medal;
    document.getElementById('final').innerHTML = score + '<small> / ' + round.length + '</small>';
    document.getElementById('tier').textContent = tier.title;
    document.getElementById('blurb').textContent = 'You got ' + score + TEXT.of + round.length + ' right. ' + tier.blurb;
    var review = document.getElementById('review');
    review.innerHTML = '';
    answers.forEach(function (ok, n) {
      var cell = document.createElement('i');
      cell.className = ok ? 'ok' : 'bad';
      cell.textContent = ok ? '✓' : '✗';
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Question ' + (n + 1) + (ok ? ' correct' : ' wrong'));
      review.appendChild(cell);
    });
    paintDots();
    document.getElementById('again').focus();
  }

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
  document.getElementById('again').addEventListener('click', function () { start(true); });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (!gameEl.hidden) fit(); });

  start(false);
</script>
`

client.command('quiz', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Quiz",
    height: 460,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The quiz opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
